description: Strong NE spear THRUST contact pose, same back-three-quarter warrior and body size. Fully STRAIGHTEN BOTH ARMS toward UPPER RIGHT: both hands well beyond the face, left hand also grips the shaft. Lean chest forward, bend front knee, rear foot planted. Drive ONE rigid diagonal spear up-right so its single SILVER TIP reaches near x148,y16; lower-left butt stays plain wood. Keep feet near y150, original adult proportions, scars, pants, chains and dagger. Transparent, no ground or new props.
